meta.frame_index: round(t*24); every table uses ABSOLUTE frame indices of the reference
meta.method: per-frame model fit (numpy): (frame-cleanplate) ~= opacity * shift(blur(scale(settled-cleanplate))). dy>0 = element is BELOW its rest position. opacity of gradient text is underestimated after settle because the gradient keeps animating (R2<1); timings/translation are unaffected. Tools: /opt/aieditor-work/reference/work/data-cards/{fit,meas,txa,border,card,col,band,sfx}.py
meta.strip_label_warning: kit/strip.sh labels are off by +1 frame-number when START*24 has a fractional part < .5 (ffmpeg seeks to the next frame). All numbers here come from frame-exact seeks ((n-0.25)/24).

typography.family: Space Grotesk (Google Fonts), weight 700 Bold, for EVERY element of this family (numbers, $, labels, headings, pills, small captions)
evidence: Rendered Space Grotesk 700 '41,023' / 'STILL RUNNING.' side-by-side with the reference crop: glyph-for-glyph match (work/data-cards/cmp1.png)
'1' has a long flag and no foot ('41,023', '11', '1 UGC AD', '$100', '100x')
'3' has a FLAT top (Z-like) in '41,023', '30 DAYS', '3 SALES'
'2' straight diagonal into flat base; '0' squarish-oval; 'G' has spur + horizontal bar; 'N' with ink-trap notches; '$' with a full vertical stroke through the S
Proportional, NOT monospaced (the pink monospace 'BUDGET' at 0:40 belongs to another family; its likely mate is Space Mono Bold)
alternates: Space Mono Bold (only if a monospaced numeral is wanted; not observed in this family)
Familjen Grotesk 700 / Host Grotesk 700 are the next-closest but have round-top 3 and footed/short-flag 1 - rejected
typography.tracking: ~0 (measured widths within +-2% of Space Grotesk 700 at the derived size; e.g. '41,023' 318px measured vs 323px rendered at 104px => ~-0.01em)
typography.size_rule: floating stacks: value line = 1.65-2.3x the label line; metric list lines equal size

colours.gradient_behaviour: ANIMATED fill on every pink number/word (=, $250, $100, $1,000, HOOK RATE, CTR, CPL, ~$100, $240, $$$, 20,000, AD 2, 11, $80, 0/3 SALES, 10 LEADS, $240 REVENUE, card-2 border, pill). Centre of the text stays hot red (#FD0A3D +-) the whole time while both ends cycle through yellow -> coral -> red -> magenta -> pink -> pale pink, i.e. consistent with a multi-stop LINEAR gradient whose ANGLE rotates around the text centre (or a large conic/mesh gradient drifting). No measurable period within 4.5 s (8807-8921). Per-frame samples in gradient_samples_E250.

confidence.font Space Grotesk 700: high (glyph-level overlay match). Would change only if a licensed look-alike (e.g. a commercial grotesk) renders identically.
confidence.R1 timings/translation: high: 15 independent lines agree to +-1px / +-0.05 opacity. Blur sigma: medium (sigma grid 0,1,2,3,4,6,8; small values are hard to separate from opacity).
confidence.R1 start at k0-2 / 15.4px total travel: medium: the first 2 frames are invisible so the start is inferred from the curve fit; any (start,travel) pair on the same curve gives identical visible frames.
confidence.R2-R5: medium: fewer samples; gradient fills make opacity estimates biased low after k3 (R2 0.8-0.95).
confidence.card slide easings: high for x (rms 1.4/3.7px); rotation +-0.3 deg (moment-based, contaminated by inner text)
medium-low: 2D moments of a partly-visible card; a 3D flip could also produce this - check frames 3243-3246 visually before building
confidence.sizes px: medium (+-3%): derived from ink height / Space Grotesk metrics
confidence.colours: medium: AA and compression; gradients are animated so any single frame is only a sample
confidence.gradient animation model: low-medium: centre-pinned red + cycling ends is measured, the generating mechanism (rotating linear vs mesh) is inferred
confidence.SFX: see per-item; floating text 'pops' not found
confidence.B notifications / dots / heading word re: medium-low: timed from strips at frame accuracy but not curve-fitted
